symbols.coverage: Borrowed source and Unix byte path; empty/path-limit/input-limit precedence; 16 MiB legacy default source cap returns InputLimit with parse diagnostic None/offset 0 and default native flags before tokenization; bounded tokenizer capacity; tokenize before native destination calls; exact XML category/offset; source bytes passed unchanged to native replace/create; replace NotFound falls back to no-replace create; only write gate forwarded on create; native file-sync/commit/directory-sync state returned.
symbols.ownership: Rust source/path are borrowed. Tokens are owned in SourceSaveResult and its lifetime is tied to source because spans index those bytes. No source copy is made.
tests: validation_precedence_and_tokenizer_diagnostics_prevent_destination_calls (empty source: IncompleteDocument at offset 0, all adapter gates untouched)
symbols.errors: SourceSaveError categories match the C enum. Native replacement errors retain native category; create errors map Ok and Durability directly, all other create errors to Io, matching C behavior (including collision/race).

symbols.coverage: Exact strings: ok, invalid, input_limit, path_limit, tokenizer, destination, durability; unknown enum values are not representable in Rust.

Preserves source error categories, XML diagnostic category/offset, native file result category and synced/renamed/directory-synced flags. Rust-owned tokenizer output replaces the caller token array while preserving its capacity bound.

safe_adaptations: C pointer-plus-length validation is represented by valid borrowed slices; null-with-nonzero-length cannot be constructed. Empty source remains valid input to the tokenizer; empty path remains invalid.

The accepted vexel-xml API uses fallible Vec reservations and reports reservation exhaustion as XmlError::OutputExhausted, the same category it uses for caller token-capacity exhaustion. Source save preserves that typed tokenizer diagnostic and maps it to SourceSaveError::Tokenizer. Its API does not distinguish system out-of-memory from token capacity exhaustion, so no deterministic OOM result or test is invented.
Create adapter forwards only before_write. Other create gates retain native defaults, matching the C wrapper's write-only hook forwarding. Successful hooks permit actual native operations.
downstream: Later application integration must close the documented 100 MiB workflow gap; this API intentionally retains the legacy 16 MiB limit and does not establish full-product completion.
